CNF Technologies is seeking Software Developers at various levels to deliver secure coding and DevSecOps practices in support of mission operations. This role involves driving technical direction across multiple efforts, ensuring alignment with mission and security objectives throughout the development cycle of cyberspace capabilities.
Enterprise Software
Information Technology
Software
CRM

No H1B
Security Clearance Required
U.S. Citizen Only
Responsibilities
Design and implement DevSecOps pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) processes tailored to compartmented intelligence environments
Perform secure software assessments, code analysis, vulnerability scanning, threat modeling, and remediation to identify and mitigate risks in new/existing software
Provide technical leadership by mentoring junior developers, conducting peer code reviews, guiding secure development practices, and collaborating with cross-functional teams
Translate mission requirements into secure software solutions, develop prototypes, proofs-of-concept, and production-grade code supporting national security objectives
Ensure deliverables comply with DoD cybersecurity policies, supply chain risk mitigation, and documentation for authorization to operate (ATO) systems

Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, C++, or Python
Knowledge of secure coding principles, software development lifecycle (e.g., Agile, Waterfall), and tools for code analysis, debugging, and testing
Understanding of cybersecurity principles, network security, risk management, vulnerabilities assessment, and integration of security features like encryption and access controls into software
Must be a U.S. citizen
Ability to work in a secure facility and willingness to undergo CI polygraph examinations and background investigations in compliance with all DoD policies and operational security standards
Must comply with DoD Manual 8140.03 requirements for the Software Developer (DCWF Work Role 621) or equivalent cyberspace role
